newsitem.title: USA: Disk drive makers, rumors fuel Nasdaq gains.
newsitem.headline: Disk drive makers, rumors fuel Nasdaq gains.

text.p: Nasdaq shares surged Thursday, riding high on bullish comments about several disk drive makers and some takeover rumors, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index gained 18.03 points or 1.35 percent to close unofficially at 1353.58.
"There's some strong feelings out there on disk drive companies. Intel and Gateway had a great day...Plus, there's some market rumors that gave a few smaller stocks a boost," one trader said.

Disk drive makers Quantum Corp and Western Digital Corp jumped after analysts at Lehman Brothers and SoundView Financial initiated coverage with bullish ratings. Gateway 2000 Inc surged after positive comments at the firm's annual meeting and a pending move to the New York Stock Exchange. Meanwhile, Informix Corp, the most heavily-traded Nasdaq issue, jumped nearly 24 percent on takeover speculation, traders said.
Intuit Inc rose 3-3/16 to 27-1/8 after a report that it was a takeover target, a market analyst said.
Advancing issues beat declining issues 2191 to 2036 on total volume of 617 million share. Nasdaq shares have posted gains in six of the previous 10 sessions.
